subject: Where does the latest Shiny Server attempt to write output files? (Joe?)  app now broken.

messages.author: 5117fd6c9c423ce1
messages.subject: Where does the latest Shiny Server attempt to write output files? (Joe?)  app now broken.
parts:
Hi all.

I have a Shiny app that has been working fine (relatively!) under a CentOS 6.3 system, Shiny vers. 7  I'm using the Shiny server.

I recently updated to 8.0.1 Shiny.  I now am having problems with writing intermediate data from the app to disk.
Before, Shiny would write intermediate data that the app saved  to the directory where the server.R and ui.R reside.
Now, it does not.

 I am using the rgdal library in this specific instance (works with GIS shapefiles).  I can run R from my server machine and save data using the same write call as my app, no problem, from the command line.  But the write call to rgdal fails when I am using Shiny server.  I imagine it is a permissions problem, but I don't know where Shiny is trying to write to.  Did something change in how or where Shiny server saves data?   The directory I think I'm trying to save to (where the app code is) is owned by the user shiny.  Any ideas what is different?

messages.subject: Re: Where does the latest Shiny Server attempt to write output files? (Joe?)  app now broken.
parts:
Cyndy,

If you still see the problem after you update your Shiny Server, please provide the following information:

- Version of Shiny Server
- Contents of the configuration file you are using for Shiny Server
- Permission settings of the directory your application is being served off (default location is /srv/shiny-server, but your configuration could be different)

Thanks,
Fereshteh
